verdict.rationale: Medusa Cloud's pricing page lists a "Cloud Development Agent", which suggests a first-party agent users can hand work to. But it is a bare feature-list mention with no documentation of what tasks it takes, how it is invoked, or whether it lives inside the admin. The MCP server and the "guardrails for agents" framework claim serve external AI tools, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of the agent's in-product delegation flow, the scope of tasks it handles, admin/dashboard integration, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
